counting_rules: One latest branch-aware target result per current feature; retired is inventory status, not runtime proof.
Every admitted raw ledger row is retained in attempts, including distinct branches, repeats and explicit supplemental interpretations; BASE never replaces TARGET.
Only exact frozen TARGET/BASE evidence is admitted; smoke, preflight, candidate, harness and other-source runs are excluded.
Parser-only dry runs are listed separately as excluded provenance; they neither replace runtime outcomes nor supply coverage.
Artifact references identify locally preserved evidence, not public copies of those files. No artifact body or private state is included.
CLI raw report is local-only and follows its own latest-row-per-run-and-feature contract; it must not be used for unique-feature or branch counts.
